independent_review.scope: Source and schema review of the finite epoch-002 measurement caller; no execution or result acceptance.

resolved_review_finding.finding: Protocol long runs reached the short comparator before their streaming verifier, exposing valid large result histograms to a 64 MiB control-file limit.
resolved_review_finding.resolution: Long protocol identity checks now bypass that short reader and full result parsing. The unchanged streaming long verifier checks complete operation, recovery, drain, resource and duration evidence.
resolved_review_finding.status: Resolved by source inspection; not runtime tested.

checks: Actual before/common build receipts and functional-before bind the immutable base admission. A separate final descriptor must identify the same admission and exact selected after build/B18; original external package equality remains required.

The outer reservation is acquired before full admission. Protocol children use a distinct timing lock. All commands use the unchanged finite owner and its complete owned/adopted-process retirement proof.
Each destination is fresh. Failed child receipts and logs are preserved; interruption does not silently resume or replace a cohort.

The ten-scene numeric noise projection is matched to exact completed before-only executions, original band receipts, actual remote retrieval receipt, saved returned bytes and exact publication commit/path/blob. The caller performs no publication.

Original protocol/codec CLI and result/noise schemas were read. Database comparator differs by exactly one raw final-state condition: product Disposed, direct/managed Stopped; resource-release and correctness checks remain.

PostgreSQL must record 18.0|on|on|on, exact tool identities and successful original owned shutdown. Actual database files are checked only against their own role/route, including selected provider and Server native hashes.

Capacity retains ordered ladder/refinement and three fresh 60-second confirmations. Validity and service qualification remain separate. Generator failures are not a server-capacity upper bound; correctness, recovery or retirement failures cannot earn a passing outer qualification.
Long rates stay fixed, independent of descriptive calibrator proposals. A matching completed role capacity proof must contain three passing confirmations at or above the fixed rate.

The unchanged long verifier requires all terminal successes, complete raw counts, bounded lag, exact status/payload oracles, successful same-process recovery and final drain. Both actual dispatch span and ordinary last-dispatch minus earliest-completion lower bound must reach 1800 seconds.
limits: Review used bounded source reads, schema comparison and hashes only; no caller import, build, test, service or workload was run.
All source is prospective. Populated admission, publication/readback and execution receipts must be real and independently inspected when available.
The before admission has no final runtime selection. A later final descriptor cannot relabel existing baseline binaries or workloads.
Existing measurement limits remain: sampled resource observations, unavailable PostgreSQL service/SQL/pool/lock timing and unavailable internal SQLite retry counts are not inferred.
No historical epoch result or diagnostic receives new long credit.
